questions.question: Who among the following options is not a recipient of the Nobel Prize in Physics 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Richard Robson**____**.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

 
• The **2025 Nobel Prize in Physics was awarded to John Clarke, Michel H. Devoret, and John M. Martinis **for their work on macroscopic quantum mechanical effects in electric circuits.
 
• This discovery revealed that quantum mechanical phenomena, once thought to be limited to atomic and subatomic scales, could be observed in systems large enough to be seen and held.
 
• Richard Robson received Nobel Prize in Chemistry.

questions.question: The National Council for Educational Research and Training (NCERT) has signed an MoU with which institution to strengthen educational research, development, and technology integration?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**IIT-Madras.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **NCERT signed a Memorandum of Understanding with IIT-Madras in New Delhi to enhance educational research, teacher training, and integration of technology-driven learning tools.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The collaboration aligns with the goals of the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020 to promote innovation and digital transformation in education.**
 
• **It aims to introduce Information Technology (IT), Artificial Intelligence (AI), and Machine Learning (ML)-enabled learning systems in schools.**
 
• **The partnership focuses on research, data analytics, and the creation of multilingual digital learning platforms.**
 
• **The MoU supports the development of advanced educational resources and teacher training modules using technology integration.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• NCERT__

 __
 
• Established: 1961
 
• Headquarters: New Delhi
 
• Functions: Educational research, curriculum design, and teacher training under the Ministry of Education.
 
 
 
• IIT-Madras__
 __
 
• Established: 1959
 
• Location: Chennai, Tamil Nadu
 
• Renowned for innovations in AI, Machine Learning, and education technology research.
 
 
 
• National Education Policy (NEP) 2020__
 
 
• Aims to transform India’s education system through multidisciplinary learning, digital inclusion, and skill-based education.
 
• Promotes collaboration between academia and technology institutions to modernize educational frameworks.

questions.question: In October 2025, which senior IPS officer of the 1993 batch was appointed as the new Director General of the Central Industrial Security Force (CISF)?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Praveer Ranjan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Praveer Ranjan and Praveen Kumar Take Charge of CISF and ITBP.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Praveer Ranjan earlier served as Special DG, CISF__, heading the sensitive Airport Security Division.**
 
• **As CISF Chief, he will oversee protection of __airports, ports, PSUs, metro systems, and nuclear plants__.**
 
• **His leadership is expected to further strengthen __critical infrastructure security__ in India.**
 
• **Appointment came after the retirement of __R.S. Bhatti__ as CISF DG.**
 
• Praveen Kumar appointed Director General of ITBP.
 
• ITBP Role: Secures India-China border, conducts mountain warfare training, and assists in Himalayan disaster relief operations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Central Industrial Security Force (CISF)**__

 __
 
• Established – 1969.
 
• Functions – Secures airports, metro networks, PSUs, nuclear and space installations.
 
• HQ – New Delhi.
 
 
 
• **Indo-Tibetan Border Police (ITBP)**__
 __
 
• New DG – Praveen Kumar (1993 batch IPS).
 
• Tasked with guarding the India-China border across high-altitude terrains.
 
• Also conducts mountain warfare training and disaster relief.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Appointments**__
 __
 
• Come at a time of rising security needs at critical installations__ and heightened __LAC vigilance__.
 
• Expected to enhance operational preparedness of CAPFs.
 
 
 
• __**R.S. Bhatti**__
 
 
• Former CISF DG, retired on superannuation in September 2025.

questions.question: Which city hosted the fifth edition of the Indo-Indonesian Joint Bilateral Maritime Exercise, ‘Samudra Shakti – 2025’?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Visakhapatnam.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The fifth edition of the Indo-Indonesian Joint Bilateral Maritime Exercise, ‘Samudra Shakti – 2025’, is being hosted at Visakhapatnam by the Indian Navy.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Exercise ‘Samudra Shakti’ aims at enhancing interoperability and strengthening mutual understanding between the Indian and Indonesian navies.**
 
• **The exercise was first conducted in 2018 and is a key bilateral engagement between the two countries.**
 
• **The exercise consists of two phases: Harbour Phase and Sea Phase.**
 
• **The Sea Phase includes various operational coordination exercises such as Helicopter Operations, Air Defence Exercises, and Weapon Firing Drills.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Harbour Phase__

 __
 
• Focuses on building camaraderie and enhancing professional understanding between the two navies.
 
 
 
• Sea Phase__
 
 
• Involves complex operational coordination with drills such as VBSS (Visit, Board, Search and Seizure), Helicopter Operations, and Air Defence Exercises.
 
• These activities improve the capabilities of both navies in responding to various maritime challenges.

questions.question: What new authentication methods for UPI transactions were unveiled at the Global Fintech Fest 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Biometric and Wearable Glass-based Authentication.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI), in collaboration with the Reserve Bank of India (RBI), unveiled biometric and wearable glass-based authentication for UPI transactions at the Global Fintech Fest 2025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The new system allows users to authenticate UPI payments using facial recognition or fingerprints linked to their Aadhaar, potentially replacing the traditional UPI PIN.**
 
• **The introduction of biometric and wearable glass-based authentication aims to enhance security, ease of use, and financial inclusion, especially benefiting senior citizens and rural populations.**
 
• **Wearable Glass Payments enable users to complete small-value transactions with a voice command and quick QR scan without the need for a phone, PIN, or touch.**
 
• **NPCI’s latest upgrade also includes multi-signatory accounts for joint account holders, improving transparency and convenience.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Biometric Authentication__

 __
 
• A method of authenticating payments through fingerprint or facial recognition linked to Aadhaar, offering enhanced security and privacy.
 
 
 
• Wearable Glass Payments__
 __
 
• New feature that allows hands-free payments through wearable smart glasses, enabling quick transactions with voice commands and QR scans.
 
 
 
• Multi-Signatory Accounts__
 __
 
• Allows joint account holders to require multiple approvals for transactions, offering added security and convenience.
 
 
 
• UPI Lite__
 
 
• A feature enabling smaller, faster transactions with reduced need for extensive authentication methods like PIN or phone access.

questions.question: The World Bank has approved a $280 million loan for which Indian state KHSIP to strengthen healthcare access and climate resilience?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The World Bank has sanctioned a $280 million loan for the Kerala Health System Improvement Programme (KHSIP) to improve healthcare access, longevity, and system resilience in the state.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The programme aims to serve 11 million elderly and vulnerable citizens, with special focus on chronic disease management and digital healthcare integration.**
 
• **It will digitally track and treat 90% of registered patients suffering from hypertension and diabetes through individual electronic health records.**
 
• **Includes home-based care for bedridden and elderly individuals, and aims for a 60% rise in cancer screening for cervical and breast cancer.**
 
• **Implements climate-resilient healthcare designs, energy-efficient systems, and flood management infrastructure in districts like Wayanad, Kozhikode, and Palakkad.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Loan Details__

 __
 
• Amount – $280 million provided by the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD).
 
• Tenure – 25 years with a 5-year grace period.
 
• Implementing Agency – Kerala State Health Department in coordination with local urban and rural bodies.
 
 
 
• Digital Integration__
 __
 
• Expansion of eHealth platforms and data management systems.
 
• Improved cybersecurity and AI-driven analytics for disease control.
 
 
 
• Community Focus__
 __
 
• Promotes rational antibiotic use and stronger laboratory networks for emerging diseases.
 
• Enhances preventive health education through gram panchayats and municipalities.
 
 
 
• Environmental Impact__
 
 
• Supports Kerala’s adaptation to floods and heatwaves through climate-resilient facility design and renewable energy integration.

questions.question: What is the rank of India’s passport in the Henley Passport Index for 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**85th.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **India’s passport is ranked 85th in the Henley Passport Index for 2025, granting visa-free access to 57 countries.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **India’s passport has dropped from 80th place in 2024 to 85th place in the 2025 Henley Passport Index.**
 
• **Singapore holds the top spot in the Henley Passport Index for 2025.**
 
• **The Henley Passport Index ranks passports based on the number of destinations accessible without a visa.**
 
• **The index is compiled by Henley & Partners using data from the International Air Transport Association (IATA) and in-house research.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Henley Passport Index__

 __
 
• A global ranking system evaluating passport travel freedom
 
• Based on visa-free access to destinations worldwide
 
• Compiled using data from IATA and enhanced by in-house research by Henley & Partners
 
 
 
• Singapore’s Ranking__
 
 
• Singapore currently holds the top spot in the Henley Passport Index for 2025
 
• Singaporean passport holders can access the most destinations visa-free

questions.question: Where was India’s first Semiconductor Innovation Museum inaugurated?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Hyderabad.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The Semiconductor Innovation Museum was inaugurated on October 12, 2025, in **Hyderabad** by the Technology Chip Innovation Program (T-Chip).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The museum showcases India's growing capabilities in **semiconductor design and manufacturing**.
 
• It will act as a hub for **innovation, investment, and talent discovery** in the semiconductor and electronics ecosystem.
 
• The museum displays advanced exhibits like India’s first **indigenous AI chip**, **AI-powered humanoid robots**, and next-gen **EV technology**.
 
• The initiative aligns with India's ambition to become a global **semiconductor hub**, positioning Hyderabad as an emerging innovation cluster.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Semiconductor Innovation Museum**__: India's first museum dedicated to showcasing semiconductor and electronics technologies.
 
• __**Technology Chip Innovation Program (T-Chip)**__: A program aimed at fostering innovation in the semiconductor sector in India.
 
• __**Hyderabad**__: A key destination for fabless chip design, advanced electronics manufacturing, and AI R&D, home to major tech players.
 
• __**India Semiconductor Mission (ISM)**__: A government initiative to develop a robust semiconductor ecosystem in India, complementing the museum’s goals.

questions.question: Which country will soon allow Indian travelers to use UPI for transactions, according to the agreement between NPCI International Payments Ltd and NTT DATA Japan?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Japan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Indian travelers will soon be able to use **UPI** for transactions in **Japan**, following an agreement between NPCI International Payments Ltd (NIPL) and NTT DATA Japan.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Under the new MoU, UPI payments will be integrated into merchant outlets across Japan, enabling Indian tourists to use UPI for payments in INR.
 
• The agreement eliminates the need for currency conversion and foreign cards, making it easier for Indian travelers.
 
• NTT DATA, which operates CAFIS (Japan’s largest card transaction network), will help facilitate this integration.
 
• India’s UPI expansion will help in improving global payment systems, enhancing convenience and supporting India’s fintech leadership.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **UPI Global Expansion**__: UPI is already accepted in countries like Bhutan, France, Mauritius, Nepal, Singapore, Sri Lanka, and UAE.
 
• __**UPI's Role in Digital Diplomacy**__: This move supports India’s fintech diplomacy and promotes India’s soft power globally.
 
• __**Other Countries**__: UPI integration is also planned in Qatar, Oman, and the UK, though these are still in the rollout phase.
 
• __**NIPL**__: NPCI International Payments Ltd (NIPL) is working to expand UPI acceptance internationally.

questions.question: Which three major ports in India have been recognized as Green Hydrogen Hubs under the National Green Hydrogen Mission?

options.text: Mumbai Port, Kolkata Port, Chennai Port
Deendayal Port, V.O. Chidambaranar Port, Paradip Port
Visakhapatnam Port, Kochi Port, Mormugao Port
Jawaharlal Nehru Port, Kandla Port, Goa Port

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Deendayal Port, V.O. Chidambaranar Port, Paradip Port.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Ministry of New and Renewable Energy has officially recognized Deendayal Port, V.O. Chidambaranar Port, and Paradip Port as Green Hydrogen Hubs under the National Green Hydrogen Mission.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The recognition of these ports as Green Hydrogen Hubs is a significant step in India's transition towards clean energy and the development of an integrated hydrogen ecosystem.**
 
• **Ports, Shipping and Waterways Minister Sarbananda Sonowal highlighted that this is a defining moment in India's maritime journey and its pursuit of becoming net zero by 2070.**
 
• **The National Green Hydrogen Mission aims to position India as a global hub for the production, utilization, and export of green hydrogen.**
 
• **These hubs will act as focal points for the production and consumption of green hydrogen, advancing India's clean energy goals.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• National Green Hydrogen Mission__

 __
 
• A government initiative to position India as a leader in the green hydrogen sector, promoting sustainable energy solutions and the development of hydrogen hubs.
 
 
 
• Green Hydrogen Hubs__
 __
 
• Strategically located ports and industrial areas focused on the production, utilization, and export of green hydrogen, aiding in the transition to clean energy.
 
 
 
• Net Zero by 2070__
 
 
• India’s long-term goal to achieve net zero carbon emissions by 2070, as part of its commitment to sustainable development and climate action.
